dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent ring-like structures exhibit irregular, high-contrast light perimeters. One centralized 'O' shape shows a sharp gradient transition from a light outer rim to a darker interior. Adjacent structures exhibit 'C' or elongated closed-loop geometries with thin, jagged light-intensity borders.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid high-intensity clusters. Primary concentrations are located near the posterior lateral region and the proximal end of the flipper, characterized by irregular, non-gradient pixel patches of lighter tone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary triangular configuration is formed by the centroids of the three largest 'O'-shaped annuli on the upper lateral flank. This is supplemented by a linear arrangement of smaller annuli extending toward the posterior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A highly prominent, elevated, pink-toned fleshy protrusion is located on the anterior dorsal-lateral region. The structure exhibits a circular, lobulated surface texture and stands out in high contrast against the dark background fur.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, elongated, high-intensity linear structures (claws) are visible on the distal edge of the right pectoral flipper, exhibiting a sharp contrast against the darker flipper tissue.
